en.助手返回了无效数据，请重新连接。: The helper returned invalid data. Please reconnect.
en.助手已停止，可从菜单栏重新连接: Helper stopped. Reconnect from the menu bar.
en.无法启动内置助手。请重新安装完整的应用包。: Unable to start the bundled helper. Reinstall the complete app.
en.助手未连接，请从菜单栏重新连接。: Helper not connected. Reconnect from the menu bar.
en.已连接日常 Codex · 右键选择会话即可分享: Connected to Codex · Right-click a session to share
en.已连接当前 Codex · 在管理页选择会话: Connected to Codex · Select a session to share
en.请在浏览器完成独立登录: Complete the isolated sign-in in your browser
en.独立账号已登录，请刷新会话列表: Isolated account signed in. Refresh the sessions.
en.助手仍在运行。请先退出应用，再重新打开。: The helper is still running. Quit and reopen the app.
en.选择已有的独立 .coop 目录。此操作不搬迁或合并数据；请先停止使用它的其他助: Choose an existing isolated .coop directory. Data will not be moved or merged. Stop any other helper using it first.
en.请选择名为 .coop 的独立运行目录。: Select an isolated runtime directory named .coop.
en.运行目录已保存。退出并重新打开应用后生效。: Runtime directory saved. Quit and reopen the app to apply it.
en.无法保存运行目录，请检查目录权限。: Unable to save the runtime directory. Check its permissions.
en.请选择尚未共享的会话: Select a session that is not already shared
en.请填写 1–40 个字符的显示名称: Enter a display name of 1–40 characters
en.本次共享已取消，请重新操作: Sharing was cancelled. Please try again.
en.共享失败：请确认会话已有首轮记录，且公网中继可连接: Unable to share. Start a conversation in Codex and check the public relay connection.
en.会话已归档或不在当前 Codex 索引中，请刷新列表: The session was archived or is no longer indexed. Refresh the list.
en.无法只读访问 Codex 会话索引；请确认 Desktop 已运行且索引版本受支: Unable to read the Codex session index. Check that Desktop is running and compatible.
en.公网连接尚未就绪，请稍后重试: Public access is not ready. Please try again later.
en.请在日常 Codex 打开所选会话: Open the selected session in Codex
en.请填写有效的 Codex 会话 ID: Enter a valid Codex session ID
en.请先在日常 Codex 打开此会话；当前 Desktop 不支持安全接入: Open this session in Codex. This Desktop version does not support safe attachment.
en.无法启动共享服务。请确认端口可用，并从菜单栏重新连接。: Unable to start sharing. Check the port and reconnect from the menu bar.
en.管理操作失败，请重试。: Management action failed. Please try again.
en.本地服务无法启动。请确认日常 Codex 正在运行、版本支持接入，且运行目录未由: Unable to start the local service. Check that Codex is running, its version is compatible, and no other helper is using this runtime directory.
en.操作未完成，请检查测试窗口和网络后重试。: Action incomplete. Check the test window and network, then try again.
en.当前为隔离实验模式，请使用日常 Codex 接入模式。: This is an isolated experiment. Use the regular Codex attachment mode.
en.请直接在日常 Codex 中登录，然后重新连接助手。: Sign in through Codex, then reconnect the helper.
en.登录地址未通过检查，请在官方测试窗口中登录。: The sign-in URL could not be verified. Sign in in the official test window.
en.登录正在进行，请完成浏览器中的独立登录，或重启助手后重试。: Sign-in is in progress. Complete it in your browser or restart the helper.
en.请先安装官方 Codex Desktop，然后重试。: Install official Codex Desktop, then try again.
en.测试窗口已经打开。若它未连接，请关闭之前的测试窗口后再点击“打开 Codex”。: The test window is already open. If disconnected, close it and choose Open Codex again.
en.正在重新分享，完成后将复制新邀请…: Sharing again; the new invitation will be copied…
en.仅保存会话标识和分享设置；重新分享会生成新邀请，同伴需再次获准加入。: Only session identifiers and sharing settings are saved. Sharing again creates a new invitation and requires readmission.
en.未共享 · 旧邀请已失效: Not shared · previous invitation no longer works
en.公网入口可用 · 断网时优先恢复原链接: Public connection available · reconnects using the same link
en.公网连接波动，正在检查；暂不更换链接: Connection unstable; checking without changing the link
en.当前网络无法访问公网入口。请先检查连接；重建会使旧邀请失效。: The public address is unreachable from this network. Check first; rebuilding invalidates old invitations.
en.隧道已退出，旧邀请已停止。请重建入口后重新分享。: The tunnel stopped. Rebuild the connection, then share again.
en.入口已重建，请从分享历史重新分享并发送新邀请: Connection rebuilt. Share again from history and send the new invitation.
en.分享历史未能保存，请检查本机运行目录权限。: Share history could not be saved. Check the local runtime directory permissions.
en.连接中断，正在恢复原邀请；也可重新分享，新邀请需重新发送。: Disconnected; restoring the original invitation. Sharing again creates an invitation you must resend.
en.公网入口无法访问，请检查连接: Public address unreachable; check the connection
en.公网连接波动，正在恢复原链接: Connection unstable; restoring the original link
en.隧道已退出，请重建入口后重新分享: Tunnel stopped; rebuild the connection and share again
en.管理正在进行的共享，也可从历史重新分享。: Manage active shares or share again from history.
en.重新分享会生成新邀请；有效的个人恢复凭据可沿用准入，停止共享或移除后失效。: Sharing again creates a new invitation. A valid personal recovery credential retains admission; stopping sharing or removing the visitor invalidates it.
en.该提醒已处理或失效。: This notification has been resolved or expired.
en.访客申请、消息审批与协作异常会及时提醒；点击可查看对应事项。: Get timely alerts for join requests, message approvals and collaboration issues. Click to view the relevant item.
en.应用内提醒始终可用。系统通知需要 macOS 授权，通知中不包含消息正文。: In-app alerts are always available. System notifications require macOS permission and never include message content.
en.邀请已到期，请从分享历史重新分享。: The invitation expired. Share again from share history.
en.点击查看对应共享，工具审批仍需在 Codex 中处理。: Click to view this share. Approve tools in Codex.
en.点击打开 Codex Co²，查看并处理对应事项。: Click to open Codex Co² and review the relevant item.
en.尚未找到此会话的可接入运行状态，请重新生成邀请以加载会话。: No accessible runtime was found for this session. Generate the invitation again to load it.
en.已在 Codex 打开此会话，但尚未能接入。请等待会话加载完成后重试。: The session was opened in Codex, but could not be attached yet. Wait for it to finish loading, then try again.
en.当前系统无法自动打开 Codex 会话，请在 Codex 打开后重试。: This system cannot open Codex sessions automatically. Open the session in Codex, then try again.
en.无法打开 Codex 会话，请确认 Codex 已安装并正在运行后重试。: Could not open the Codex session. Check that Codex is installed and running, then try again.
en.连接 Codex 超时，请确认 Codex 正在运行后重试。: Connecting to Codex timed out. Check that Codex is running, then try again.
en.查找会话超时，请确认 Codex 可响应后重试。: Finding the session timed out. Check that Codex is responsive, then try again.
en.消息提交响应超时，结果待核实；请在 Codex 确认，不要重复发送。: The message submission response timed out; delivery is uncertain. Check in Codex before sending again.
en.等待 Codex 响应超时，请检查连接后重试。: Waiting for Codex timed out. Check the connection, then try again.
en.默认最多同时共享 10 条会话，可自定义或选择无限制。: Share up to 10 sessions at once by default. Choose a custom limit or unlimited.
en.保存后立即生效并保留；调低上限不会停止已有共享。: Saved changes apply immediately and persist after restart. Lowering the limit keeps existing shares active.
en.请输入大于 0 的整数，或选择无限制。: Enter a positive whole number, or choose unlimited.
en.共享上限未能保存，请重试。: Could not save the sharing limit. Try again.
en.共享上限必须为正整数或无限制: The sharing limit must be a positive whole number or unlimited
en.此安装包仅支持连接日常 Codex。隔离实验请从源码运行。: This package only connects to your existing Codex Desktop. Run isolated experiments from source.
en.入口重建中，稍后可重新分享…: Rebuilding connection; you can share again shortly…
en.入口建立中，稍后可重新分享…: Preparing connection; you can share again shortly…
en.检查完成，公网入口连接正常: Check complete. The public connection is working.
en.检查完成，公网入口仍不可用，请检查网络或重建入口。: Check complete. The public address is still unreachable. Check your network or rebuild the connection.
